mapper.insert: INSERT INTO brain_workers ( external_id, max_sessions, busy_sessions, resident_sessions, admission_failures, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.MaxSessions}, #{params.BusySessions}, #{params.ResidentSessions}, #{params.AdmissionFailures}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET max_sessions = EXCLUDED.max_sessions, busy_sessions = EXCLUDED.busy_sessions, resident_sessions = EXCLUDED.resident_sessions, admission_failures = EXCLUDED.admission_failures, last_seen_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() RETURNING circuit_failures, circuit_open_until, (xmax = 0) AS inserted
mapper.update: UPDATE brain_workers SET circuit_failures = #{params.CircuitFailures}, circuit_open_until = #{params.CircuitOpenUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE external_id = #{params.ExternalID}
mapper.select: SELECT max_sessions, busy_sessions, resident_sessions FROM brain_workers WHERE last_seen_at > #{seenAfter} AND (circuit_open_until IS NULL OR circuit_open_until <= NOW())
